fbx_side_check.interpretation: The asset-path prefix is NOT embedded in the FBX. It is injected downstream by the CARLA import/MoveAssets commandlet stage, which writes DestinationPath as /Game/<package>/Static/<tag>/<name> (Import.py generate_import_setting_file, and move_assets_commandlet). Therefore the serialized reference producer is in the CARLA commandlet path, not in the offline FBX generator. This is consistent with the offline COOK_LOG claiming boundary 'Offline FBX generation only'.
